9:

92:   - 是本项目直接可执行的构建脚本（偏“项目级快捷入口”）。
93:   - 已封装好目标：`make cli`、`make web`、`make gui`、`make all`。
94:   - 适合 Linux/macOS 和已安装 `make` 的环境，命令短、上手快。
95: 
96: - `CMakeLists.txt`：
97:   - 是跨平台构建描述文件（偏“生成器配置”）。
98:   - 先由 `cmake -S . -B build` 生成对应平台的构建系统，再 `cmake --build build` 调用编译器。
99:   - 更适合 Windows/Visual Studio 场景，也便于 IDE 集成。
100: 
101: 本项目当前的功能覆盖差异：
102: 
103: - `Makefile`：支持 CLI / Web / GUI 三个目标。
104: - `CMakeLists.txt`：默认构建 CLI，`-DBUILD_GUI=ON` 可构建 GUI；Web 目标暂未纳入 CMake。
105: 
106: 建议使用方式：
107: 
108: - 想快速跑通课程框架：优先 `make`。
109: - 在 Windows（尤其是 Visual Studio）上：优先 CMake 流程。
110:

112: 
113: ## 核心模块说明
114: 
115: ### 1. 文本处理与索引构建
116: 
117: | 文件 | 函数 | 说明 |
118: |------|------|------|
119: | TextProcessor.cpp | `toLowerCase()` | 字符串转小写 |
120: | TextProcessor.cpp | `tokenize()` | 文本分词 |
121: | InvertedIndex.cpp | `addDocument()` | 构建倒排索引 |
122: | InvertedIndex.cpp | `getTopTerms()` | 获取高频词 |
123: 
124: **数据结构：**
125: ```cpp
126: struct Posting {
127:     int docId;      // 书籍ID
128:     int chapter;    // 章节号
129:     int line;       // 行号
130:     int position;   // 单词位置
131: };
132: 
133: // 倒排索引: 单词 -> 出现位置列表
134: std::map<std::string, std::vector<Posting>> index_;
135: ```
136: 
137: ### 2. 搜索功能
138: 
139: | 文件 | 函数 | 说明 |
140: |------|------|------|
141: | SearchEngine.cpp | `search()` | 单词搜索 |
142: | SearchEngine.cpp | `searchAND()` | AND 查询 |
143: | SearchEngine.cpp | `searchOR()` | OR 查询 |
144: | SearchEngine.cpp | `searchPhrase()` | 短语搜索 |
145: 
146: ### 3. 上下文显示
147: 
148: 显示搜索结果所在位置的前后段落（上一段落、当前段落、下一段落）。
149: 
150: ### 4. 字符串匹配算法对比
151: 
152: | 算法 | 时间复杂度 | 核心思想 |
153: |------|------------|----------|
154: | Brute Force | O(nm) | 逐位置尝试匹配 |
155: | KMP | O(n+m) | 失败函数避免重复比较 |
156: | Boyer-Moore | O(n/m)~O(nm) | 从右向左 + 坏字符规则 |
157: | Rabin-Karp | O(n+m) 平均 | 滚动哈希快速比较 |

129:              sizeof(serverAddr)) < 0) {
130:         std::cerr << "Failed to bind to port " << port << std::endl;
131:         CLOSE_SOCKET(serverSocket_);
132:         return false;
133:     }
134: 
135:     if (listen(serverSocket_, 10) < 0) {
136:         std::cerr << "Failed to listen" << std::endl;
137:         CLOSE_SOCKET(serverSocket_);
138:         return false;
139:     }
140: 
141:     running_ = true;
142:     serverThread_ = std::thread(&HttpServer::serverLoop, this);
143: 
144:     std::cout << "Server started at http://localhost:" << port << std::endl;
145:     return true;

163: void HttpServer::serverLoop() {
164:     while (running_) {
165:         struct sockaddr_in clientAddr;
166:         socklen_t clientLen = sizeof(clientAddr);
167: 
168:         SocketType clientSocket = accept(serverSocket_,
169:             (struct sockaddr*)&clientAddr, &clientLen);
170: 
171:         if (clientSocket == SOCKET_INVALID) {
172:             if (running_) {
173:                 std::cerr << "Accept failed" << std::endl;
174:             }
175:             continue;
176:         }
177: 
178:         // 处理客户端请求（简单实现，单线程处理）
179:         handleClient(clientSocket);
180:         CLOSE_SOCKET(clientSocket);
181:     }
182: }

184: void HttpServer::handleClient(SocketType clientSocket) {
185:     constexpr size_t kBufferSize = 8192;
186:     constexpr size_t kMaxRequestSize = 50 * 1024 * 1024;  // 50MB
187:     char buffer[kBufferSize];
188:     std::string rawRequest;
189:     rawRequest.reserve(kBufferSize);
190: 
191:     size_t expectedTotalSize = 0;
192:     bool headerParsed = false;
193: 
194:     while (true) {
195:         std::memset(buffer, 0, sizeof(buffer));
196: 
197: #ifdef _WIN32
198:         int bytesRead = recv(clientSocket, buffer, sizeof(buffer), 0);
199: #else
200:         ssize_t bytesRead = recv(clientSocket, buffer, sizeof(buffer), 0);
201: #endif
202: 
203:         if (bytesRead <= 0) {
204:             break;
205:         }
206: 
207:         rawRequest.append(buffer, static_cast<size_t>(bytesRead));
208: 
209:         if (rawRequest.size() > kMaxRequestSize) {
210:             return;
211:         }
212: 
213:         if (!headerParsed) {
214:             size_t headerEnd = rawRequest.find("\r\n\r\n");
215:             if (headerEnd != std::string::npos) {
216:                 headerParsed = true;
217:                 size_t contentLength = parseContentLength(rawRequest.substr(0, headerEnd));
218:                 expectedTotalSize = headerEnd + 4 + contentLength;
219: 
220:                 if (contentLength == 0 || rawRequest.size() >= expectedTotalSize) {
221:                     break;
222:                 }
223:             }
224:         } else if (rawRequest.size() >= expectedTotalSize) {
225:             break;
226:         }
227:     }
228: 
229:     if (rawRequest.empty()) {
230:         return;
231:     }
232: 
233:     if (expectedTotalSize > 0 && rawRequest.size() > expectedTotalSize) {
234:         rawRequest.resize(expectedTotalSize);
235:     }
236: 
237:     HttpRequest request = parseRequest(rawRequest);
238:     HttpResponse response;
239: 
240:     // 查找路由
241:     std::string routeKey = request.method + " " + request.path;
242:     auto it = routes_.find(routeKey);
243: 
244:     if (it != routes_.end()) {
245:         it->second(request, response);
246:     } else if (!staticDir_.empty() && request.method == "GET") {
247:         // 尝试提供静态文件
248:         if (!serveStaticFile(request.path, response)) {
249:             response.setNotFound();
250:         }
251:     } else {
252:         response.setNotFound();
253:     }
254: 
255:     std::string responseStr = buildResponse(response);
256:     send(clientSocket, responseStr.c_str(), responseStr.length(), 0);
257: }

259: HttpRequest HttpServer::parseRequest(const std::string& raw) {
260:     HttpRequest request;
261:     std::istringstream stream(raw);
262:     std::string line;
263: 
264:     // 解析请求行
265:     if (std::getline(stream, line)) {
266:         // 移除 \r
267:         if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') {
268:             line.pop_back();
269:         }
270: 
271:         std::istringstream lineStream(line);
272:         lineStream >> request.method >> request.path;
273: 
274:         // 解析查询字符串
275:         size_t queryPos = request.path.find('?');
276:         if (queryPos != std::string::npos) {
277:             request.query = request.path.substr(queryPos + 1);
278:             request.path = request.path.substr(0, queryPos);
279: 
280:             // 解析参数
281:             std::istringstream queryStream(request.query);
282:             std::string param;
283:             while (std::getline(queryStream, param, '&')) {
284:                 size_t eqPos = param.find('=');
285:                 if (eqPos != std::string::npos) {
286:                     std::string key = urlDecode(param.substr(0, eqPos));
287:                     std::string value = urlDecode(param.substr(eqPos + 1));
288:                     request.params[key] = value;
289:                 }
290:             }
291:         }
292:     }
293: 
294:     // 解析头部
295:     while (std::getline(stream, line) && line != "\r" && !line.empty()) {
296:         if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') {
297:             line.pop_back();
298:         }
299:         size_t colonPos = line.find(':');
300:         if (colonPos != std::string::npos) {
301:             std::string key = line.substr(0, colonPos);
302:             std::string value = line.substr(colonPos + 1);
303:             // 去除前导空格
304:             while (!value.empty() && value[0] == ' ') {
305:                 value = value.substr(1);
306:             }
307:             request.headers[key] = value;
308:         }
309:     }
310: 
311:     // 读取 body
312:     std::ostringstream bodyStream;
313:     bodyStream << stream.rdbuf();
314:     request.body = bodyStream.str();
315: 
316:     return request;
317: }

319: std::string HttpServer::buildResponse(const HttpResponse& response) {
320:     std::ostringstream stream;
321: 
322:     stream << "HTTP/1.1 " << response.statusCode << " "
323:            << response.statusText << "\r\n";
324: 
325:     for (const auto& header : response.headers) {
326:         stream << header.first << ": " << header.second << "\r\n";
327:     }
328: 
329:     stream << "Content-Length: " << response.body.length() << "\r\n";
330:     stream << "Connection: close\r\n";
331:     stream << "\r\n";
332:     stream << response.body;
333: 
334:     return stream.str();
335: }

337: std::string HttpServer::urlDecode(const std::string& str) {
338:     std::string result;
339:     for (size_t i = 0; i < str.length(); ++i) {
340:         if (str[i] == '%' && i + 2 < str.length()) {
341:             int value;
342:             std::istringstream iss(str.substr(i + 1, 2));
343:             if (iss >> std::hex >> value) {
344:                 result += static_cast<char>(value);
345:                 i += 2;
346:             } else {
347:                 result += str[i];
348:             }
349:         } else if (str[i] == '+') {
350:             result += ' ';
351:         } else {
352:             result += str[i];
353:         }
354:     }
355:     return result;
356: }

358: std::string HttpServer::getMimeType(const std::string& path) {
359:     size_t dotPos = path.rfind('.');
360:     if (dotPos == std::string::npos) {
361:         return "application/octet-stream";
362:     }
363: 
364:     std::string ext = path.substr(dotPos);
365:     if (ext == ".html" || ext == ".htm") return "text/html; charset=utf-8";
366:     if (ext == ".css") return "text/css; charset=utf-8";
367:     if (ext == ".js") return "application/javascript; charset=utf-8";
368:     if (ext == ".json") return "application/json; charset=utf-8";
369:     if (ext == ".png") return "image/png";
370:     if (ext == ".jpg" || ext == ".jpeg") return "image/jpeg";
371:     if (ext == ".gif") return "image/gif";
372:     if (ext == ".svg") return "image/svg+xml";
373:     if (ext == ".ico") return "image/x-icon";
374: 
375:     return "application/octet-stream";
376: }

378: bool HttpServer::serveStaticFile(const std::string& path, HttpResponse& response) {
379:     std::string filePath = staticDir_;
380:     if (path == "/") {
381:         filePath += "/index.html";
382:     } else {
383:         filePath += path;
384:     }
385: 
386:     std::ifstream file(filePath, std::ios::binary);
387:     if (!file.is_open()) {
388:         return false;
389:     }
390: 
391:     std::ostringstream content;
392:     content << file.rdbuf();
393:     file.close();
394: 
395:     response.statusCode = 200;
396:     response.statusText = "OK";
397:     response.headers["Content-Type"] = getMimeType(filePath);
398:     response.body = content.str();
399: 
400:     return true;

struct Occurrence { int bookId; int chapter; int line; int wordIndex; };

Current codebase pattern: SearchEngine is already mostly a retrieval core, but it still leaks query-parsing responsibility via executeQuery.

What the code actually does:
- CLI: parses commands in cli_main.cpp; single-word search goes directly to InvertedIndex::search(); compound queries call SearchEngine::searchAND/OR/NOT/phrase/near; context is assembled in CLI.
- Web: handler parses mode in web_main.cpp; single-word search uses InvertedIndex::search(); AND/OR/phrase use SearchEngine; context is a separate /api/context endpoint.
- GUI: MainWindow calls SearchEngine::executeQuery(query); result display and context snippet building happen in GUI code.
- SearchResult in SearchEngine.h is a leaky DTO: it carries context/score, but executeQuery only fills docId/chapter/line and sets score=1.0; context stays empty.
- executeQuery is a very simple string parser (AND/OR/NOT/NEAR/phrase fallback) and does not handle richer grammar/precedence well.

Pros of your proposed boundary:
- Keeps SearchEngine focused on retrieval semantics over Posting lists.
- Lets frontend/controller own query syntax, mode selection, and UX-specific result formatting.
- Matches existing CLI/Web patterns better than the current GUI-centric executeQuery path.
- Reduces coupling to UI grammar and makes future query-language changes easier.

Cons / coupling risks:
- Current code is inconsistent: CLI/Web bypass executeQuery, GUI depends on it.
- SearchResult mixes core and presentation concerns; context and score are not truly core here.
- Context generation is duplicated and inconsistent: CLI/Web use paragraph-level context; GUI uses ±2 lines.
- Single-word search is split between InvertedIndex and SearchEngine, which weakens a single abstraction boundary.
- Global state in web_main.cpp and cached bookContents_ in GUI tightly couple search, storage, and presentation.

Recommended boundary:
- Keep in SearchEngine: only index-backed retrieval primitives (word lookup wrapper if you want one, plus AND/OR/NOT/phrase/near over Posting lists).
- Move out of SearchEngine: query parsing/composition, mode dispatch, result formatting, ranking/scoring policy, and all context assembly.
- Best shape: frontend/controller parses user intent, calls SearchEngine primitives, then a shared service formats results/context for CLI/Web/GUI.
- If executeQuery must remain, treat it as a thin adapter in the application layer, not as core SearchEngine responsibility.

Bottom line: your proposed architecture is directionally correct, and the current codebase already leans that way; the main cleanup is to remove executeQuery from the core boundary and make all UIs consume the same retrieval/service layer.

而 **CLI/GUI 不是 HTTP 前端**，它们直接调用核心类，不走这些 `/api/...` 路由。

### 1) `web_main.cpp` 暴露的全部 HTTP API
- `POST /api/upload?name=...&title=...`  
  - body: 原始 txt 文本  
  - 返回：`{success, docId, name, lines, vocabulary, totalTerms}`

- `GET /api/load?file=...&name=...`  
  - 旧兼容接口，从服务端文件系统读文件  
  - 返回同上（或 error）

- `GET /api/files`  
  - 返回当前已加载书籍列表：`dataDir, hint, loadedBooks[]`

- `GET /api/search?q=...&mode=single|and|or|phrase`  
  - 返回：`query, mode, count, results[]`
  - `results[]` 每项含：`book, bookName, chapter, line, context`

- `GET /api/context?doc=...&line=...`  
  - 返回：`docId, bookName, line, previousParagraph, currentParagraph, nextParagraph`

- `GET /api/stats`  
  - 返回：`documents, vocabulary, totalTerms, books[]`

- `GET /api/top?n=20`  
  - 返回：`words[{word,count}]`

- `GET /api/autocomplete?prefix=...`  
  - 返回：`suggestions[]`

- `GET /api/spelling?word=...`  
  - 返回：`word, suggestions[]`

- `GET /api/compare?pattern=...`  
  - 返回：`pattern, textSize, algorithms[]`
  - `algorithms[]` 每项含：`name, matches, comparisons, timeMs, complexity`

### 2) `static/index.html` 实际调用的接口
主搜索页只用到了这些：
- `/api/stats`
- `/api/top?n=30`
- `/api/search?q=...&mode=...`
- `/api/context?doc=...&line=...`
- `/api/autocomplete?prefix=...`

也就是说：  
**前端主搜索页有“统计 / 高频词 / 搜索 / 上下文 / 自动补全”五类能力。**

### 3) `static/upload.html` 实际调用的接口
- `/api/files`
- `/api/upload?name=...`（POST，body 为 txt 内容）

### 4) 前端有没有调用 fuzzy / spelling / compare / load？
- **没有**  
  当前 `static/index.html` 和 `upload.html` 都**没调用**：
  - `/api/load`
  - `/api/spelling`

- `/api/spelling` 是后端已暴露但前端没用；
- `/api/compare` 也是后端已暴露但前端没用；
- `/api/load` 只是旧兼容接口，README 里有说明。

### 5) 搜索参数与行为要点
- Web 搜索页的 `mode` 只有：`single / and / or / phrase`
- Web 版 `handleSearch()` **没有用** `SearchEngine::executeQuery()`，而是自己按 `mode` 分发：
  - `single` → `g_index->search(query)`
  - `and` → 前两个词做 AND
  - `or` → 前两个词做 OR
  - `phrase` → `searchPhrase(query)`

### 6) CLI / GUI 区别（重要）
- **CLI (`cli_main.cpp`)**
  - 不是 HTTP
  - 命令式：`load / list / search / context / compare / and / or / not / phrase / near / spell / complete / top / stats`
  - 功能比 Web 前端更“全”

- **GUI (`main.cpp` + `gui/MainWindow.cpp`)**
  - 也不是 HTTP
  - 直接调用核心类
  - 支持本地自动补全、统计、搜索模式切换
  - 代码里还能看到 `NOT / NEAR / Fuzzy` 之类模式，但这不是 Web API

20: std::string normalize_word(std::string_view word) {
21:     std::string normalized;
22:     normalized.reserve(word.size());
23: 
24:     for (unsigned char ch : word) {
25:         if (std::isalnum(ch) != 0) {
26:             normalized.push_back(static_cast<char>(std::tolower(ch)));
27:         }
28:     }
29: 
30:     return normalized;
31: }

33: std::vector<std::string> tokenize(std::string_view text) {
34:     std::vector<std::string> words;
35:     std::istringstream stream{std::string{text}};
36: 
37:     for (std::string raw_word; stream >> raw_word;) {
38:         std::string word = normalize_word(raw_word);
39:         if (!word.empty()) {
40:             words.push_back(std::move(word));
41:         }
42:     }
43: 
44:     return words;
45: }

140: Option<std::vector<Index>> SearchEngine::search_add(std::string_view query) const {
141:     std::vector<std::string> words;
142:     std::unordered_set<std::string> seen_words;
143: 
144:     for (std::string& word : tokenize(query)) {
145:         if (seen_words.insert(word).second) {
146:             words.emplace_back(std::move(word));
147:         }
148:     }
149: 
150:     if (words.empty()) {
151:         return std::nullopt;
152:     }

154:     std::unordered_map<size_t, size_t> book_match_counts;
155: 
156:     for (const std::string& word : words) {
157:         const auto found = inverted_index.find(word);
158:         if (found == inverted_index.end()) {
159:             return std::nullopt;
160:         }
161: 
162:         std::unordered_set<size_t> matched_books;
163:         for (const Index& index : found->second) {
164:             matched_books.emplace(index.book_id);
165:         }
166: 
167:         for (size_t book_id : matched_books) {
168:             book_match_counts[book_id]++;
169:         }
170:     }
171: 
172:     std::unordered_set<size_t> matched_books;
173:     for (const auto& [book_id, count] : book_match_counts) {
174:         if (count == words.size()) {
175:             matched_books.insert(book_id);
176:         }
177:     }
178: 
179:     if (matched_books.empty()) {
180:         return std::nullopt;
181:     }
182: 
183:     std::vector<Index> matches;
184:     for (const std::string& word : words) {
185:         const auto& indices = inverted_index.at(word);
186: 
187:         for (const Index& index : indices) {
188:             if (matched_books.contains(index.book_id)) {
189:                 matches.push_back(index);

199: Option<std::vector<Index>> SearchEngine::search_phrase(std::string_view query) const {
200:     const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(query);
201:     if (words.empty()) {
202:         return std::nullopt;
203:     }
204: 
205:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(words.front());
206:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end()) {
207:         return std::nullopt;
208:     }
209: 
210:     std::vector<Index> matches;
211:     for (const Index& start : first_word->second) {
212:         std::vector<Index> phrase_match{start};
213:         bool is_phrase = true;
214: 
215:         for (size_t offset = 1; offset < words.size(); ++offset) {
216:             const auto found = inverted_index.find(words[offset]);
217:             if (found == inverted_index.end()) {
218:                 return std::nullopt;
219:             }
220: 
221:             const auto next = std::ranges::find_if(found->second, [&](const Index& index) {
222:                 return index.book_id == start.book_id && index.chapter_id == start.chapter_id &&
223:                        index.line == start.line && index.word_idx == start.word_idx + offset;
224:             });
225: 
226:             if (next == found->second.end()) {
227:                 is_phrase = false;
228:                 break;
229:             }
230: 
231:             phrase_match.push_back(*next);
232:         }
233: 
234:         if (is_phrase) {
235:             matches.insert(matches.end(), phrase_match.begin(), phrase_match.end());
236:         }
237:     }
238: 
239:     if (matches.empty()) {
240:         return std::nullopt;
241:     }
242: 
243:     std::ranges::sort(matches, {}, cmpr);
244:     return matches;
245: }
